items.quote: the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones. For the message he declared
items.contrast: The man of God declared the warning, while the father is the one recounting it to his sons.
items.reason: Within the father's speech, “he” refers back to the man of God, whereas the father refers to himself as “my.” The question therefore tests who originally declared the warning rather than who later spoke about it.
